## CRM · Morning call list (Lesson 5.9)
Every day at 07:30, one Telegram message to Tolu:
- Call first: ready contacts (harvest_score 65+, Sales qualified lead) with no call or contact logged yet.
- Going cold: open deals with no activity for 7 days.

Credentials: HubSpot App Token credential (the "n8n Growth Desk" private app token, with only contact, company and deal read/write scopes, plus tasks if you create tasks); Telegram.
Placeholders: YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ filterGroups: [ { filters: [ { propertyName: 'harvest_score', operator: 'GTE', value: '65' }, { propertyName: 'lifecyclestage', operator: 'EQ', value: 'salesqualifiedlead' }, { propertyName: 'notes_last_contacted', operator: 'NOT_HAS_PROPERTY' } ] } ], sorts: [ { propertyName: 'harvest_score', direction: 'DESCENDING' } ], properties: ['firstname', 'lastname', 'company', 'harvest_score'], limit: 10 }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ filterGroups: [ { filters: [ { propertyName: 'hs_is_closed', operator: 'EQ', value: 'false' }, { propertyName: 'notes_last_updated', operator: 'LT', value: String(Date.now() - 7 * 864e5) } ] } ], properties: ['dealname', 'dealstage', 'notes_last_updated'], limit: 20 }) }}
